description.value: Taves Family Farms is a three-generation working farm in Abbotsford's Fraser Valley offering seasonal agri-tourism experiences across spring, summer, and fall — from tulip and pumpkin gardens to apple orchard u-pick, petting barns, hayrides, and a jumping pillow. Founded in 1990 by the Taves family, it also operates an estate cidery and on-site Country Store. A touring cyclist in the Fraser Valley would find this a distinctive rural detour with food and farm goods available on site.
